headline: Key dependencies for textual.app.App class
what_breaks: src/textual/dom.py — relies on App for rendering structure
src/textual/widget.py — depends on App for widget lifecycle
src/textual/_context.py — uses App for active application context
why: The App class is foundational for the Textual framework, serving as the base for all applications. Changes here can significantly impact the rendering and functionality of dependent modules.
checklist: Review changes to the App class methods and properties.
Ensure compatibility with widget lifecycle in widget.py.
Verify DOM structure updates in dom.py.
